ink.$description: Text color shared by native prose code and the code-block listing by default.

canvas.$description: Background shared by native prose code and the code-block listing by default.

font-family.$description: Font family shared by native prose code and the code-block listing by default.

font-size.$description: Font size shared by native prose code and the code-block listing by default.

font-weight.$description: Font weight shared by native prose code and the code-block listing by default.

line-height.$description: Line height shared by native prose code and the code-block listing by default.

tab-size.$description: Tab width shared by native prose code and the code-block listing by default.

inline-padding-inline.$description: Inline inset around code embedded in a prose sentence.

inline-padding-block.$description: Block inset around code embedded in a prose sentence.

inline-border-radius.$description: Corner radius around code embedded in a prose sentence.

block-padding-inline.$description: Inline inset shared by native prose code listings and the code-block listing by default.

block-padding-block.$description: Block inset shared by native prose code listings and the code-block listing by default.

block-border-color.$description: Border color shared by native prose code listings and the code-block frame by default.

block-border-width.$description: Border width shared by native prose code listings and the code-block frame by default.

block-border-style.$description: Border style shared by native prose code listings and the code-block frame by default.

block-border-radius.$description: Corner radius shared by native prose code listings and the code-block frame by default.

spacing-before.$description: Incoming spacing request when a native code listing follows another direct child in a .prose flow. The resolved gap is the larger of this spacing-before and the previous treatment's spacing-after, so structural hierarchy wins without relying on source order.

spacing-after.$description: Outgoing spacing request contributed by a native code listing to the next direct child in a .prose flow. The resolved gap is the larger of this spacing-after and the next treatment's spacing-before; documented compound pairs may intentionally use the tighter outgoing gap.
